name: Estonia
summary: Using drugs or possessing a small amount is a misdemeanour, not a crime (fine up to 300 units ≈ €1,200, or detention). Larger amounts, supply and growing cannabis are crimes.
callingForHelp: 'Good Samaritan' police practice: overdose calls often get only an ambulance; police attend if unsafe or minors are involved, and may waive small-amount cases.
drugChecking: State institute TAI anonymously tests drug-residue items (bags, syringes) left at harm-reduction centres in Tallinn, Narva and Kohtla-Järve.

lsd.note: Controlled. Using or holding a small amount is a misdemeanour (fine or detention); supply is a crime.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin mushrooms are explicitly controlled; small-amount possession is a misdemeanour.

dmt.note: DMT controlled (ayahuasca counts as a DMT preparation); small-amount possession is a misdemeanour.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is controlled; small-amount possession is a misdemeanour.

dox.note: Controlled individually or via substance groups (list VI, since 2016); small amounts are a misdemeanour.

nbomes.note: Controlled individually or via substance groups (list VI, since 2016); small amounts are a misdemeanour.

2c-x.note: Controlled individually or via substance groups (list VI); small amounts are a misdemeanour.

2c-t-x.note: Controlled individually or via substance groups (list VI); small amounts are a misdemeanour.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-DMT and related tryptamines controlled (incl. via substance groups); small amounts are a misdemeanour.

cannabis.note: Small amount (about 7.5 g) is a misdemeanour: fine up to ~€1,200 or detention. Growing cannabis is a crime. CBD products sold legally.

ketamine.note: Controlled substance: unprescribed use or small-amount possession is a misdemeanour; larger amounts are a crime.

mxe.note: Controlled; small-amount possession is a misdemeanour.

dxm.note: Not verified. DXM is not under the UN drug conventions; whether it is OTC or prescription-only in Estonia was not confirmed.

nitrous.note: Not a controlled drug; national sales rules not verified. EU ban on consumer sales expected from Feb 2027.

amphetamines.note: Small amounts: misdemeanour (fine or detention); larger amounts and supply are crimes. ADHD medicines by prescription.

mdma.note: Using or holding a small amount is a misdemeanour; larger amounts or supply are crimes (1–10+ years).

cocaine.note: Using or holding a small amount is a misdemeanour; larger amounts or supply are crimes.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18 (sale, serving and supply to under-18s banned); shop sales limited to 10:00–22:00.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is controlled (small amounts a misdemeanour). The status of GBL and 1,4-BD was not verified.

opioids.note: Heroin, fentanyl and other opioids: small-amount possession is a misdemeanour; larger amounts carry long prison terms.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine. Whether unprescribed possession is itself an offence was not verified.

benzodiazepines.note: Psychotropic substances: unprescribed use or small-amount possession is a misdemeanour.

maois.note: Medical MAOIs are prescription-only; harmala/Syrian rue not known to be controlled. Ayahuasca contains DMT (controlled).
